title: How One Prayer Before Your Inbox Changes a Godly Man's Whole Workday
caption:
A godly man prays before he opens his inbox. Ninety seconds that change how the whole day gets worked.

It puts the work under something bigger than the next deadline. It kills the urge to perform for whoever emails first. It makes the boring parts sacred instead of beneath you. And it ends the day different than it started.

Try it tomorrow morning before the first tab opens.
